items.headline: I built a desktop workspace that lets Claude keep working on long-horizon tasks, and it’s FREE
items.summary: I’ve been working on this for a while and finally got the OSS desktop/runtime path into a shape I felt good sharing here, since Claude is one of the Best fit model for it. It’s called Holaboss. Basically it’s a desktop workspace + runtime that lets Claude hold ongoing work, not just answer a prompt. items.headline: VertAX: a differentiable vertex model for learning epithelial tissue mechanics
items.summary:
arXiv:2604.06896v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Epithelial tissues dynamically reshape through local mechanical interactions among cells, a process well captured by vertex models. Yet their many tunable parameters make inference and optimization challenging, motivating computational frameworks that flexibly model and learn tissue mechanics.
